title: sambucus nigra var. canadensis
intro: Sambucus nigra var. canadensis, commonly known as American Black Elderberry, is a deciduous shrub native to North America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including reducing inflammation and relieving symptoms of colds, flu, and other respiratory infections. The therapeutic actions of American Black Elderberry include anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as anthocyanins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. The bioactive constituents of American Black Elderberry work together to provide antioxidant and immune-boosting effects, making it a valuable natural remedy for various health conditions.
